alternatives.label: Vanity Mirror Blush
alternatives.reason: Ivory and dusty rose surfaces with bronze-gold accents and a soft high-contrast serif give the app the warm, low-glare feel of a lit dressing table, so money screens feel personal rather than corporate.

alternatives.label: Backstage Ring Light

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

alternatives.reason: A deep charcoal-plum stage backdrop with champagne-gold labels and a warm-white spotlight on balances makes money figures and overdue alerts the brightest things on screen, like a ring light on a face.

alternatives.label: Foundation Shade Card
alternatives.reason: The palette borrows the warm beige and deep umber steps of a foundation shade card, so pending and overdue states read as tonal lightness and depth, with one sienna accent reserved for actions and flat surfaces with a tracked geometric sans keeping the tool precise and swatch-clean.

alternatives.label: Letterpress Invoice Ink
alternatives.reason: A cream-paper ledger aesthetic with ink-navy type, hairline rules, and vermilion reserved solely for overdue and urgent money, so the app reads like a printed bookkeeping page where red marks what needs chasing.
